decisions.reason: Strong early adoption by a major public customer and connectivity to over 30 government APIS schemes already reveals clear value, so this option merits further commitment.

With no visible traction beyond a standalone listing and travel health rules fading by 2024, the market uncertainty has resolved enough to suggest limited upside relative to keeping resources tied up.
Cyber security awareness training is adjacent to the firm's training capabilities, inexpensive to keep available, and still sits in a market with growing demand and unresolved upside.

Although evidence is still thin, behaviour-analysis security fits the firm's airport and critical-infrastructure base, and as an expanding large firm it can afford to keep this option open a bit longer while uncertainty remains.
Passenger security profiling appears commercially and regulatorily harder to scale in Germany and Europe, and without visible traction the option value looks too weak to justify continued attention.
A travel and document verification platform is close to the core offer, relevant to existing customers, and a standalone presentation suggests enough promise to continue learning from the market.
